away.name: Dustin Wolf
away.news: Wolf finished as the Calder Trophy runner-up as a rookie in the 2024-25 season, but followed it with a disappointing 2025-26 season, posting a 3.01 GAA and .899 SV% in 57 games (23-29-3). Hoping to return to form in 2026-27, Wolf has played poorly, reflecting a struggling team in front of him that has scored only eight goals in five games (0-5-0). The 25-year-old American goalie has an ugly 5.42 GAA and .816 SV% in three games this season (0-3-0). The Flames enter Tuesday's contest as +148 road underdogs against a 4-1-0 Anaheim Ducks team.

home.name: Lukas Dostal
home.news: Dostal's play hasn't been very encouraging to start the 2026-27 season, but he owns a solid 3-1-0 record and returns to the crease on Tuesday against the Calgary Flames. The 26-year-old Czech goalie was solid in his previous outing, saving 16 of 17 shots (.941 SV%) in a 5-1 win over the Winnipeg Jets, bouncing back after allowing five goals on 17 shots (.706 SV%) in a 5-2 loss to the Edmonton Oilers. The Ducks enter Tuesday's contest as -164 home favourites against a winless Calgary Flames team (0-5-0) that has been outscored 8-27.

away.name: Devon Levi
away.news: Neither Tristan Jarry nor Devon Levi has been spectacular to start the 2026-27 season, but Levi hasn't lost yet and will return to the crease on Tuesday against the Los Angeles Kings. The 24-year-old Levi is coming off a strong performance, stopping 29 of 31 shots (.935 SV%) in a 5-2 win over the Anaheim Ducks, and is 3-0-0 with a 3.35 GAA and .863 SV% this season. The Oilers enter Tuesday's contest as -130 road favourites against a winless Kings team that has been outscored 17-10 through four games (0-2-2).

home.name: Darcy Kuemper
home.news: After finishing his first season with the Kings in 2024-25 as the second Vezina Trophy runner-up, Kuemper followed it with a disappointing 2025-26 season, posting a 2.78 GAA and .891 SV% in 50 games (19-14-15). Looking to get back on track in 2026-27, Kuemper's start hasn't been encouraging, posting an ugly 4.03 GAA and .868 SV% through three games (0-2-1). The Kings enter Tuesday's contest as +177 road underdogs against the Edmonton Oilers, who have scored 20 goals during a four-game winning streak.

away.name: Jeremy Swayman
away.news: Jeremy Swayman had a miserable 2024-25 season after signing a massive eight-year contract extension, posting an ugly 3.11 GAA and .892 SV% in 58 games (22-29-7). The organization had concerns about the contract, but he followed it up with a solid 2025-26 season, posting a 2.71 GAA and .907 SV% in 55 games (31-18-4). Now, the 27-year-old goalie seems to be continuing his upward trajectory, opening the season with an outstanding 1.79 GAA and .932 SV% through five games (4-1-0). The Bruins enter Tuesday's contest as -120 road favourites against a San Jose Sharks team that has scored just four goals in their last three games (0-2-1).

home.name: Yaroslav Askarov
home.news: Askarov has struggled to start the 2026-27 season, but will return to the crease on Tuesday for his fifth start in six games. The 24-year-old goalie allowed three goals on 17 shots (.850 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 3-1 loss to the Edmonton Oilers. He has a 3.71 GAA and .860 SV% in four games (2-2-0). The Sharks enter Tuesday's contest as slight +109 home underdogs against a Boston Bruins team that has outscored opponents 11-2 in their last two games (2-0-0).
